purpose: Research-only seed registry for the Digital Lab OS Bio/Neuro Evidence Atlas.
safety_boundary: Trial registrations are evidence of planned/ongoing research, not evidence of efficacy. This registry does not provide personal-use stimulation instructions or operational stimulation parameters.
promotion_rule: ONGOING may be promoted only after posted results or a linked publication are independently assessed by the Evidence Gate.

trials.title: Memory Enhancement in Aging With Optimal Dosing
trials.research_question: How do different high-resolution tACS schedules affect memory-related outcomes in healthy older adults?

trials.title: Memory Enhancement in Aging With Closed-Loop tACS
trials.research_question: Can adaptive, brain-guided tACS improve memory-supporting network outcomes in healthy older adults?

trials.title: High-Frequency Repetitive Transcranial Magnetic Stimulation for Cognitive Improvement in Patients With Post-Stroke Cognitive Impairment
trials.research_question: Do active versus sham rTMS conditions produce measurable cognitive and neurophysiological differences in post-stroke cognitive impairment?

trials.title: Transcranial Ultrasonic Neuromodulation of Primary Visual Cortex and Primary Auditory Cortex in Humans
trials.research_question: How does transcranial focused ultrasound influence sensory-cortex responses and perception under controlled research conditions?

trials.title: Targeted Circuit-Based Transcranial Focused Ultrasound Intervention for Obsessive-Compulsive Disorder TUS-OCD
trials.research_question: Can targeted ultrasound neuromodulation alter clinically relevant outcomes in OCD while meeting safety and feasibility constraints?

trials.title: Towards a Targeted Ultrasound Neuromodulation Intervention for Alcohol Abuse Disorders
trials.research_question: Can targeted ultrasound neuromodulation influence symptoms and cognitive flexibility in alcohol use disorder?
